subject: Reseller addendum: VAT / withholding and invoicing routing clarifications
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dana Lee <dana.lee@cloudsell.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Reseller addendum: VAT / withholding and invoicing routing clarifications

Dana — attaching our latest redline of the marketplace/reseller addendum (MSA + Order Form attachment). Two asks up front so we can keep the procurement loop moving: 

1) Confirmation on VAT handling for EU end-customer invoices: do you require Redwood to invoice CloudSell gross (Redwood shows VAT) and then CloudSell issues to end-customers, or should Redwood be able to zero-rate when we receive a valid CloudSell VAT registration? We included a proposed clause at section 4.2 to allow zero-rating on receipt of a certificate.

2) Withholding / tax gross-up: CloudSell mentioned local withholding may apply in some LATAM jurisdictions. We added a short carve-out in section 5.4 but need clarity on whether CloudSell needs Redwood to accept reduced amounts (and provide tax receipts) or if CloudSell expects gross-up language in the order form. This impacts how we book revenue and our finance approvals.

Attachments: Redwood_Marketplace_Addendum_v3.docx (redlines enabled) and a sample VAT cert template.

If easier, happy to jump on a 20m call with procurement + finance tomorrow. Proposed next steps at the bottom of the doc.

Thanks — Laura

Laura Bennett
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0193

---

From: Dana Lee <dana.lee@cloudsell.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: CloudSell Finance <ops@cloudsell.com>, Tom Harris <tom.harris@cloudsell.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 14:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Reseller addendum: VAT / withholding and invoicing routing clarifications

Laura — thanks for the redline. A few quick points from ops/finance that will determine what CloudSell needs: 

- VAT: For EU deals where CloudSell is the reseller of record, we will generally provide our VAT registration and expect Redwood to zero-rate (so long as we appear on the invoice as reseller). We can share the standard VAT certificate; I attached the one we typically send.
- Withholding: LATAM is messy. Our default policy is to remit the gross amount and seek local tax credit where possible; however in some countries tax authorities require withholding at source and CloudSell will deduct and provide a withholding tax receipt. We will flag whether a specific country requires gross-up during the SOW.

On the redline language: we can accept Redwood's proposed zero-rating clause if you add a short process (document upload and validation) and a 30-day cure window before CloudSell withholds. For withholding/gross-up I'd like explicit options in the order form: (a) CloudSell withholds and provides receipt, or (b) CloudSell pays gross with gross-up. Which is your preference to offer?

Happy to take a quick call tomorrow morning EU time.

Best,
Dana

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 11:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Reseller addendum: VAT / withholding and invoicing routing clarifications

Folks — I reviewed the draft and flagged the commercial and legal impact. Key notes: 

- Zero-rating: acceptable if CloudSell provides a valid VAT registration and the invoice lists CloudSell as reseller of record. Add a data/submission trail requirement (we prefer an email timestamp + PDF upload to the deal folder). I suggest the clause read: 
  "Supplier may apply zero-rated VAT where Buyer provides a valid VAT registration number and documented evidence of reseller status; Supplier shall have 30 days to validate the documentation prior to invoice adjustment."

- Withholding / gross-up: we should provide both options in the order form. We cannot commit to absorbing withholding (it impacts revenue recognition and tax filings). So implement: Option A (Buyer withholds; Buyer provides original receipts) and Option B (Buyer pays gross + gross-up language). Add an optional tick-box on the order form to select treatment per-transaction.

- Indemnities / reporting: add line that CloudSell will supply withholding tax certificates within 45 days. If not provided, Redwood may issue a consolidated remittance invoice and expect CloudSell to reimburse. Keep the indemnity narrow and tied to documented local law.

- Accounting/ERP: Vivek, please confirm whether a 45-day receipt window is workable for AR and revenue recognition. If not, suggest changes.

I'll incorporate redline suggestions directly into the attached DocX and re-send.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Dana Lee <dana.lee@cloudsell.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 09:47:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Reseller addendum: VAT / withholding and invoicing routing clarifications

Dana / Laura — quick commercial note from Sales: whichever option we offer, we need the order form UX to be explicit and not add friction. Cloud partners frequently object to hidden gross-up exposures. Two practical asks: 

1) If we add the tick-box for withholding treatment, surface expected amounts in the estimator (so CloudSell can preview net vs gross).
2) If CloudSell elects to withhold, add a field to capture the local tax authority and expected withholding rate. That will speed Finance reconciliation and commission calc.

If we can get the UX/ops mapping this week, I can keep the deal on the current close schedule.

Thanks — Ben

---

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dana Lee <dana.lee@cloudsell.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 16:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Reseller addendum: VAT / withholding and invoicing routing clarifications

Quick finance confirmation: 45 days for receipt of withholding certificates is borderline but acceptable for this customer given the deal size (DEAL-2026-0421). Process notes: 

- If CloudSell withholds and provides receipts within 45 days we will accept net payment and record appropriate tax credit.
- If receipts are not provided in 45 days Redwood may re-issue an invoice for the outstanding withholding amount plus an administrative fee (flat $250) and request CloudSell reimburse.
- For zero-rated VAT we need the VAT reg plus a signed reseller statement; finance will validate within 10 business days. If validation fails, Redwood will issue corrected invoice plus interest from original due date.

Action items: 
- Kimberley/Kimberly: fold the legal redlines into section 4.2 / 5.4 and include the 30/45 day windows.
- Laura/Marissa: propose a short order-form UX mock (tick-box + withholding rate field) by Thu 24 Jun.
- Ben: update the estimator flow and let us know if commission calc needs a separate flag.

I'll approve once legal and ops language is in the DocX; Laura, please circulate a DocuSign link once the final redline is accepted.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
